messages:
Jamal: FYI seeing a burst of preemptible A100 evictions in us-central1-a for ~90m — nodes live ~4-6m then gone, CA thrashing, some jobs stuck Terminating due to CNI detach failures.
Alex W: ugh. autoscaler logs show rapid add/remove and drain errors referencing eni detach timeouts. job retries spiking.
Maria K: same short-burst pattern we saw before. these transient waves confuse the scale-down logic.
infra-bot: [alert] spot-interruption-rate(us-central1-a): 0.22 -> threshold(0.10) — consider fallback to on-demand buffer.
Jamal: proposal: bump CA flags for gpu nodepools:
```
--scale-down-delay-after-add=20m
--max-empty-bulk-delete=0
--balance-similar-node-groups=true
```
also tag noisy pools with node-label preemptible-no-teardown=true to skip aggressive deletion.
Tim Ops: +1. also create gpu-warm-reserve on-demand pool at ~6% capacity (taint: reserve=critical:NoSchedule) for critical jobs (retrain + latency-sensitive rerank). cheaper than retry storms.
SRE-Oncall: we need a canary rollout. plan: apply changes to one cluster, monitor pod_terminate_success_rate, job_retry_count, and spot_eviction_rate for 48h. page if job_retry_count > baseline + 30%.
Alex W: drain hook tweak: if CNI detach stalls >90s, force-evict pod (graceful->force) and mark node unschedulable. set kubelet --pod-eviction-timeout=2m. update graceful-drain script to respect the timeout.
Maria K: add recording rule: spot_evictions_rate = sum(rate(node_spot_evictions[5m])) by (zone, instance_type) / count(node) by (zone, instance_type). Alert if >0.05 for 10m.
Jamal: I'll open terraform diff + autoscaler deployment PR, include nodepool for gpu-warm-reserve and CA flag changes. tagging @Tim Ops for scheduler-extender routing change so critical queues prefer the warm pool.
infra-bot: created issue INFRA-3387: "gpu spot flapping — warm reserve + CA tuning" assigned Jamal
SRE-Oncall: quick sync in 10m to approve canary and watch metrics :thumbsup:
